capabilities: , Search titles and creators across various media types
Sync progress and ratings from external services
Populate Markdown notes with media metadata
Visualize library contents using Canvas and Shelf views
disambiguation: Not a simple file manager; it is a comprehensive media database and tracking system.
extras: The library is plain notes and opens offline. No telemetry or self-update.
problem: Users need a way to track diverse media collections (books, games, movies, etc.) and their progress within the Obsidian Markdown environment without relying solely on external databases.

relations.evidence: AniList: anime and manga lists, progress and scores; changes go back with the Push command
IMDb: ratings, episode ratings and watchlist; scores and new watchlist titles go back
Netflix: viewing history and thumbs, anime into the anime category; scores go back as thumbs
PlayStation: played games, playtime and trophies
Credly badges, Claude Academy badges, Google for Education certificates
coins, banknotes and tokens from Numista with your free Numista key

summary: Media tracking plugin that allows users to manage movies, books, games, and NFTs as structured Markdown notes, pulling data from external services.
